title: JSON boundary
summary: All untrusted JSON is parsed through a schema.
description: Untrusted JSON is JSON from SQLite, from external APIs, and whatever Tauri commands and plugins return.

requirements.text: Untrusted JSON and the results of Tauri commands are parsed through a schema in `src/lib/schemas.ts`, with a schema library such as zod, never cast.

history.text: Untrusted JSON and the results of Tauri commands are parsed through a zod schema in `src/lib/schemas.ts`, never cast.
history.reason: zod is an example of a schema library, not a requirement.

requirements.text: Schemas validate strictly: JSON that doesn't fit its schema fails to parse, except fields the schema doesn't name, which are dropped. Where parsing should be more forgiving, such as of a model's output, fields can be made optional in the schema.

history.text: Schemas for model and API output coerce and default, so a sloppy answer degrades instead of failing.
history.reason: Validation is strict; only fields the schema doesn't name are dropped instead of failing the parse.
